highlights: The Porodo Trackfit X Smart Bracelet Fitness Tracker with Display App blends a simple, screen-free look with advanced health and activity tracking.
Its zinc alloy body and IML glass give it durability and style while keeping it light and comfy enough to wear all day.
It tracks heart rate, blood oxygen, and stress through HRV analysis. The battery lasts up to 30 days in use and 40 days on standby, charging fast with a secure pogo-pin connector.
Rated IP68 for water resistance, it’s ready for workouts and everyday wear.
Works with Android 8.0+, iOS 12+, and the Porodo Fit app, quietly tracking your activity, sending reminders, and alerting you to long sitting periods without distractions.
